summary: Iran ceasefire diplomacy is pulling equities to record highs but leaving bonds under pressure, with the 30-year Treasury yield having hit a 19-year high of 5.2% on war-driven inflation fears. Stocks are riding tech momentum and peace optimism while gold sells off as safe-haven demand fades and real rates stay elevated.
tweet: Iran deal hopes lift stocks to records, but bond yields at 19-year highs and sticky inflation are keeping gold in the red and rate cuts off the table.
